citations.assessment: The consulted Eruvin reads bar Adda, supporting Heilprin’s proposed correction to the heading.
Sanhedrin gives the form son of Rav Adda, with a distinct alternative ascription to bar Avdimi.
An alternate transmission explicitly gives Yitzḥak bar Adda speaking in Rav’s name. The passage also attributes the same tradition to Aḥa bar Adda.

holds.raw: בר אדם ט"ס וצ"ל בר אדא
holds.reason: The corrected form is attested. Preserve bar Adam as the headword Heilprin transmits before correcting it.
